description: Queensland Traffic Incidents is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Queensland. Incidents, Major Events and Roadworks information including GPS coordinates. Queensland Traffic Incidents dataset receives data from qldtraffic.qld.gov.au. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are traffic incidents, disaster dashboard, emergency. The portal shows 505 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
